vulnerability_note: The fix ADDS a line: it calls _collectInterest(false) at the start of decreaseDebtShare so interest is brought up to date before the repayment is computed. The bug is the absence of that accrual, so it predates the fix and there is no clean parent. Confirmed: the parent of the fix (30fc63c) is also vulnerable (PoV PASSES there too).

commits.vic_blame: n/a (missing_code: no vulnerability-introducing commit; the accrual was never there before the fix)
commits.fix_reported_as: PR#59 (commits 8ca2a35, 81e54c0 per the report); those hashes are not present in main history. The squash-merged commit on main that adds the interest accrual to decreaseDebtShare is 0d54fae (H-2 / 7.2.2, #59).

runs.detail: no interest charged on direct repayment; amountRepaid == amountBorrowed
parent is ALSO vulnerable; the accrual did not exist before the fix

interest is accrued first, so the owed amount exceeds the borrower's balance and the full direct repayment reverts with an arithmetic underflow (panic 0x11) before the assertion is reached; interest is now charged

oracle_basis: Differential holds: PASS on vulnerable code, FAIL on the fix. This proves the PoV detects the bug and is not trivially always-passing. On the fix the failure is a revert (interest accrual raises the owed amount above the borrower's holdings), which is a valid FAIL.
